description: Create an asynchronous Feed API ActiveInventoryReport task (price and quantity of every active listing): feedType LMS_ACTIVE_INVENTORY_REPORT, schemaVersion 1.0, optional filterCriteria.listingFormat AUCTION or FIXED_PRICE. eBay answers 202; returns taskId and Location. Poll ebay_get_inventory_task, then download with ebay_get_feed_task_result_file. Requires sell.inventory.

filterCriteria.description: Limits the ActiveInventoryReport to one listing format

listingFormat.description: ListingFormatEnum: AUCTION or FIXED_PRICE; all formats when omitted

name: ebay_create_inventory_task
